text: こんど　こそ　おしえてやらあ！

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb says you do it to someone, often as a tough threat. やらあ is a rough slurred way of saying やるわ. おしえてやらあ = 'I'll teach you a lesson!'

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ puts strong stress on the word before it: 'this one and no other'. こんど　こそ = 'this time for sure'.
